name: Egg Hunt
summary: Across the Barrens, Korran seeks silithid eggs for study. The Horde scholar at the Crossroads has heard of clever insect creatures in the south and wants their intact eggs brought to Orgrimmar.

sections.title: Eyes in the Crossroads
sections.body: From the Crossroads, Korran watches the Barrens and sends reports to Orgrimmar. The Horde faces tribal conflicts and Alliance incursions, yet the land itself is changing. In the southern Barrens, intelligent insects have begun to burrow. They move as one mind.

sections.title: Excavating the Swarm
sections.body: Korran needs samples to learn where the silithid come from and what drives them. With an excavation claw, you travel to the Field of Giants and lift intact eggs from the dirt mounds. Disturb one mound and the nearby brood comes to defend it. Their coordination is uncanny.

faq.q: Who gives the Egg Hunt quest?
faq.answer: Korran gives the work at the Crossroads in the Barrens. The troll watches the region's plants, animals, and strange changes for his patrons in Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Where are the silithid eggs found?
faq.answer: Silithid eggs lie in dirt mounds at the Field of Giants in the southern Barrens. The mounds gather around tunnels beneath the land.

faq.q: What tool is needed to collect the eggs?
faq.answer: Korran provides a Digging Claw to lift the eggs without breaking their shells. You return it with twelve undamaged eggs.

faq.q: What makes these insects different from typical beasts?
faq.answer: Silithid act with eerie coordination and cunning. Korran has found their intelligence far beyond that of ordinary animals, as if they share a purpose.

faq.q: Why does Orgrimmar want silithid eggs?
faq.answer: Orgrimmar wants to learn about unknown threats near Horde lands. Studying the eggs can reveal how silithid grow, their strengths, and their biology before the infestation spreads.

faq.q: What happens when you disturb an egg mound?
faq.answer: Disturbing a silithid mound agitates the swarm. Nearby silithid attack to protect the brood.

angles.text: The Horde depends on scouts like Korran to watch Kalimdor's harsh lands. Their reports help uncover strange threats before they endanger Durotar and Mulgore.
As a troll, you know primeval creatures can be dangerous. The silithid are no ordinary bugs, and Korran is wary of their calculating minds.
